reforms.description: The Spellings Commission proposed an increase in needs-based financial grants, specifically aiming to raise the purchasing power of the average Pell Grant to 70% of the average in-state tuition at public four-year institutions over five years.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Increasing financial support for education enhances access to higher education, which can lead to a more skilled workforce.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been put into effect as part of the educational funding strategy.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform represents a significant structural change in financial aid policy aimed at improving access to education.
reforms.source_quote: The Commission concluded that 'Access to higher education in the United States is unduly limited by …persistent financial barriers …There is ample evidence that qualified young people from low-income families are far less likely to go to college than their similarly qualified peers from high-income families.'

reforms.description: The President’s Tax Reform Panel recommended reducing the deductibility of mortgage interest expense from the taxable income base and replacing it with a tax credit available to all homeowners, aimed at promoting homeownership while reducing the skew towards higher income households.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The proposed tax credit is designed to make homeownership more accessible, which can stimulate economic activity and investment in housing.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been proposed and is awaiting implementation.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant change in tax policy aimed at enhancing homeownership opportunities.
reforms.source_quote: The Panel recommended that the existing deduction be replaced with a better targeted tax expenditure, a tax credit available to all homeowners, which would be equal to 15% of mortgage interest paid.
